notes: Variant v013 is a selected unit over γάρ and leaves the projection unchanged.
οὐκέτι here and μηκέτι at 14:13 are analysed alike, headed on the temporal word (rule 24 within this chapter's habit; each verse decided on its own).
τῷ βρώματί σου: the possessive empties the article (rule 20) and the case preposition with therefore stays on the noun (rule 21's determinerless clause), as rule 47's τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν does.
